parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in the PlaybackTests target under `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.714 suggests structural overlap in their implementations, the two methods — `multiplePlayCallsAreIdempotent` and `overrideWhilePlayingIsHandled` — test distinct behavioral scenarios (idempotent play calls vs. route-change override handling) and belong to different test classes (`PlayerControllerBehaviorTests` and `RouteChangeBehaviorTests`). Any shared shape is incidental to the test-setup boilerplate common in behavior-style XCTest suites, not a sign of unintentional duplication. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent without reducing production risk.
